profile.subtitleJa: ユダヤ地方の都市。使徒言行録1章で弟子たちに留まるよう命じられる。
profile.summaryJa: ユダヤ地方の歴史的都市です。使徒言行録1章4節では、イエスが弟子たちに離れずに待つよう命じた場所として記されます。古代の市域と現在の都市区画は区別して扱います。
profile.modernLocationJa: 現在のエルサレム旧市街周辺に古代市域が重なるが、歴史的な範囲や境界は時代により異なる。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 使徒言行録1章4節で、弟子たちに留まるよう命じられる都市。
profile.locationNoteJa: 候補座標はプロフィールに昇格していない。Pleiades固定データまたは考古学機関の該当資料を個別に照合できていないためcoordinate=null。

wikipedia.title: エルサレム
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事はレバントの歴史的都市エルサレムを扱い、現代の都市とも連続する。使徒本文のエルサレムという都市名と一致。

Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.
As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

review.identityCheckJa: 使徒言行録の文脈で地名の指示対象を確認。関連箇所は直接命名と区別。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 紹介文はknownByの初出本文に限定し、後発のActs情報はknownBy付きfactsに分離。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: 記事はレバントの歴史的都市エルサレムを扱い、現代の都市とも連続する。使徒本文のエルサレムという都市名と一致。

geographyCheck.reasonJa: Wikipedia記事本文は現代所在地・歴史的同一性の補助根拠として読み、profile.sourceIdsに記録した。Wikipediaは座標根拠に用いていない。Pleiades固定データまたは考古学機関の個別照合がないためcoordinate=nullを維持。

review.remainingUncertaintyJa: 今回、同定できる適切なWikipedia記事を開いて確認できていない。未確認記事URLを設定しない。 候補座標はプロフィールに昇格していない。Pleiades固定データまたは考古学機関の該当資料を個別に照合できていないためcoordinate=null。
